components.name: Trace view tabs
components.description: Waterfall and Analysis are actual mutually exclusive tab panels. This isolated sample records their visual states; it does not implement panel switching.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;height:42px;padding:0 24px;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#2a2a2e)}.ds-tab{font:450 12px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;height:42px;padding:0;color:var(--muted-foreground,#a1a1aa);background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--foreground,#ededef);border-bottom-color:var(--foreground,#ededef)}.ds-tab span{font:10px 'Geist Mono Variable',monospace;margin-left:5px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#a1a1aa)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #91b4ee;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Selected waterfall row
components.description: 32px tree/time row with selected background and outlined 10px service bar. Layout excerpt; the full table has a 700px minimum width and sticky axis.
components.html: 140 ms
components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(320px,40%) 1fr;height:32px;background:#222b3b}.ds-operation{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 16px 0 36px;border-right:1px solid #242428;min-width:0}.ds-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0;height:100%;border:0;background:none;padding:0;font:11px 'Geist Mono Variable',monospace;color:#d2d2d9;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-name i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:1px;background:#79a9f5;flex-shrink:0}.ds-operation>span{font:10px 'Geist Mono Variable',monospace;color:#a1a1aa;white-space:nowrap}.ds-timeline{position:relative;margin:0 24px 0 12px;padding:0;border:0;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,#232327 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:25% 100%;cursor:pointer}.ds-bar{position:absolute;left:10%;width:65%;top:11px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;background:#79a9f5;outline:1px solid #dce9ff;outline-offset:2px;transition:opacity 120ms}.ds-name:focus-visible,.ds-timeline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #91b4ee;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-bar{transition:none}}

components.name: Service timing table
components.description: Flat Analysis table with mono measurements. In the app a service action returns to the filtered waterfall; values here are illustrative.
components.css: .ds-table-scroll{overflow:auto}.ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:11px 'Geist Variable',sans-serif;text-align:right;color:var(--foreground,#ededef)}.ds-table th{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted-foreground,#a1a1aa)}.ds-table thead th{padding:0 0 12px 16px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-table th:first-child{text-align:left;padding-left:0}.ds-table tbody th,.ds-table td{padding:14px 0 14px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#2a2a2e)}.ds-table td{font-family:'Geist Mono Variable',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}.ds-table button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:28px;color:#dedee4;background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-table i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:1px;background:#79a9f5}.ds-table button:hover{color:#b4cefa}.ds-table button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #91b4ee;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
A neutral developer file inspector: compact chrome, subtle hairlines, precise measurements, and minimal copy. The trace is the workspace, not content inside a dashboard shell.

Extracted from `src/lib/TraceViewer.svelte`, `src/routes/layout.css`, and the shipped button, input, tabs, and dialog primitives. Source takes precedence over older design descriptions and screenshots.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width, tree-aligned waterfall until a span is selected.
Quiet neutral chrome with color for identity and state.
Geist interface text paired with Geist Mono measurements.
dos: Do preserve tree/time alignment and tabular measurements.
Do keep neutral surfaces quiet and use color for identity or state.
Do keep view switching explicit and preserve intentional table scrolling on narrow screens.
donts: Don't reintroduce dashboard scaffolding, onboarding steps, oversized cards, or explanatory filler.
Don't use service color alone to communicate error status.
Don't hide evidence behind decorative effects or imply unsupported root-cause certainty.
